meta.description: EdCo helps organisations understand education, engage the right people and build relationships that drive awareness, leads, pipeline and growth.

hero.heading: Helping organisations build better relationships with education.
hero.standfirst: Understand educators. Create value. Build engagement.
hero.body: EdCo helps organisations understand education, engage the right people and build relationships that drive awareness, leads, pipeline and growth.

partners.heading: Schools need partners, not vendors.
partners.body1: Schools aren’t looking for suppliers. They’re looking for solutions to real problems and better outcomes.
partners.body2: If you want a meaningful relationship with educators, understand what they need, be useful, earn their attention and build their trust.
partners.close: At EdCo we love helping great companies become great partners.

howItWorks.heading: Listen. Understand. Give. Engage. Build. Grow.
howItWorks.lead:
One philosophy underpins everything we do.
We start with what you’re trying to achieve, then bring together the right combination of insight, engagement and technology.
howItWorks.closeBody: We help build awareness, engagement and interest — giving your sales team warmer, more relevant conversations with the right people.

outcomes.heading: Start with your objective. Not our org chart.
outcomes.lead: You don’t need to know which EdCo product or team you need. Tell us what you’re trying to achieve. We’ll work out what combination of intelligence, people, technology and engagement capability makes sense.

oneEdco.heading: One EdCo. Lots of ways to help.
oneEdco.lead: We don’t expect you to work out which one you need. That’s our job.

breadth.heading: Start with a capability specialist and you often start with their solution. Start with a sector specialist and you start with the problem.
breadth.body: Sometimes the answer is research. Sometimes it’s better intelligence. Sometimes it’s a different proposition, useful content, an event, a campaign, technology or several of those things together.
breadth.close: And sometimes the best advice is to change the plan altogether.

proof.heading: Relationships measured in decades, not campaigns.
proof.bodyBefore: Some customers have worked with EdCo for more than
proof.body2: Not because we’ve kept selling them the same thing. Because their objectives have changed, education has changed and we’ve changed with them.

logos.heading: Great organisations. Different objectives. One thing in common.
logos.lead: They want to understand education better and make a greater difference within it.

hearing.heading: What we’re hearing from educators right now
hearing.lead: Beyond the headlines. What educators are actually telling us and what it means for organisations working with education.
hearing.cardNote: Each item answers: what are educators telling us, where are we hearing it, why it matters, and what it could mean for organisations working with education.

freeValue.heading: Something useful before we ask you for anything
freeValue.lead: Give to receive works for us too.

featured.title: What don’t you know about your customers?
featured.body: Send us your customer list. We’ll analyse it through Education IQ and we’ll walk you through what’s in there.
